newsitem.title: USA: Garden Fresh to open restaurants in Q4.
newsitem.headline: Garden Fresh to open restaurants in Q4.

text.p: Garden Fresh Restaurant Corp said it plans to have opened eight new restaurants by the end of the current fiscal year, of which four are already opened and the remaining four are to be opened in the fourth quarter.
In fiscal 1998, its target is to open 10 new restaurants by filling out existing markets as well as entering new cities, it said.
It said it is also looking at new markets for fiscal 1999, leading off with Houston as an entre to exploring Texas as a whole.
